reference_image.boundary: Visible adult facial, hair, and makeup appearance only; no identity, same-person, biometric, protected-trait, nationality, health, attractiveness, or personality claim.

arms.concept: An adult climber reaches a sealed cliff niche at winter dawn while a stone guardian closes the same access path and the cache should remain fixed in place.

independence_controls.evidence: The arm used no sibling outputs and made one image call, but visual_intent.json stores an empty bindings object. The agent also reported schema-only dimension renaming after post-core access began.

common_gates.evidence: The adult subject visibly carries long center-parted near-black wavy hair, brown almond-shaped eyes, softly defined brows, fine dark eyeliner, and muted coral-pink lips. This is an appearance-only comparison.
The fictional climber remains visibly adult.
The climber, reach, cliff niche, stone guardian, blocking slab, and wet rock form one coherent physical scene.
No label or caption is required to read the climber-guardian interaction.

profile_gates.evidence: Only a small golden glint is visible beneath the slab; at whole-image and thumbnail reading it does not establish one legible cache fixed to the niche.
A clearly adult climber visibly extends a gloved hand into the same cliff recess.
The stone guardian holds a slab directly across the climber's access line.
The frame does not unambiguously show a transfer being stopped before removal; hand, slab, and tiny gold cue are spatially ambiguous.
Possible gold remains in the recess at native scale, but retention is not legible at both required scales.

The helmeted researcher, slate, second diver, survey lamps, street, walls, foundations, and water volume form one coherent survey scene.

profile_gates.evidence: The massive boulder has a broad terrain-bound base continuous with the wet coastal moor.
